transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Um, I'm here because things have just been really hard lately, especially at work. I'm a hairstylist, and... I don't know, my hands just feel like they’re moving through glue. Like, even simple things, like sectioning hair or mixing color, it just takes me forever now. It's gotten to the point where people have started noticing that I’m just... slower than I used to be. It's really frustrating.
Beyond the physical slowness you mentioned, have you been feeling persistently sad, empty, or down in the dumps lately?

Yeah, I have. Um... most days I just wake up with this heavy, flat sadness right in my chest. It's just always there. It kind of makes me feel like... like there’s really no point anymore in trying to build the life I was planning for myself.
Have you ever experienced a period like this in the past, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

No, I haven't really felt this way in the past. This is the first time. But it hasn't just been a few weeks or anything... it's actually been going on for about a year and eight months now. Um, it started right after my hours got cut at the salon, and my savings just began draining away.
During this year and eight months, have there been any periods of a few weeks or more where you felt like your usual self, or has this low mood been present nearly every day?

Um... looking back on it, I've spent most of this whole decline just feeling depressed and weighed down. I mean, there might have been a few shorter stretches where the sadness wasn't quite as prominent, but... yeah, for the most part, it's been there pretty much every day.
During these past twenty months, have you noticed any changes in your appetite, such as eating significantly more or less than usual?

Yeah, I've definitely been eating a lot less. Um, I've been skipping meals without really meaning to. I'll just kind of realize at night that all I've had all day is some coffee and maybe a few bites of something. I haven't weighed myself, but my clothes have definitely gotten looser on me.
How has your sleep been during these past twenty months?

Um, honestly, I haven't really noticed any major changes with my sleep. I think I've been sleeping about the same as I usually do. I mean, maybe a little tossed around sometimes because of the stress, but nothing that stands out as being really different or, you know, bad.
Over this past year and eight months, have you felt a sense of low self-esteem or felt like you aren't good enough?

Yeah, definitely. Um... I just keep thinking that I'm a burden on everyone. It feels like I deserve what's happening to me right now, honestly, because... well, I couldn't even keep my money, my job, or just my basic salon responsibilities together. So, yeah, I definitely feel that way.
During this time, have you often felt a sense of hopelessness about the future?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I feel really bad about myself and where I'm at right now, but I wouldn't say I feel completely hopeless about the future. I guess I still think things could get better eventually, even if I'm messing everything up at the moment. So, no, I just haven't really had that feeling.
